description: This Ruby source file defines classes and methods for generating and managing HTML documentation pages from XML input files. It includes classes for handling module documentation, chapters, indexes, and assembling the final HTML output with navigation features. The script reads XML files, processes their content to extract documentation elements, and produces HTML pages as documentation output.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Base class providing HTML documentation page structure, navigation, and formatting utilities.

classes.name: GenericModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Represents generic module documentation with methods for parsing and rendering module components.

classes.name: ModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Handles detailed documentation for a module, including actions, setups, options, and sections.

classes.name: AngelModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Specialized module documentation for 'angel' modules with custom item parsing.

classes.name: ChapterDocumentation
classes.description: Processes chapter-specific documentation XMLs with sections and examples.

classes.name: ModuleIndex
classes.description: Generates a HTML index page listing modules and their components.

classes.name: IndexPage
classes.description: Creates a table of contents index page linking to other documentation pages.

classes.name: AllPage
classes.description: Aggregates all documentation pages into a single comprehensive HTML page.

methods.name: loadXML
methods.description: Loads an XML documentation file and returns a corresponding documentation object based on root node.
